subject: FY22 Academic and Technology Budget Priorities
overview: The committee reviewed Fiscal Year 2022 budget requests for mathematics, English learners, technology, and athletics, projecting a total funding increase between $3.4 million and $5.8 million. The session focused on utilizing federal relief funds for staff restoration, academic intervention camps, and modernizing classroom technology.

items.title: Mathematics Department Priorities
items.summary: Proposed restoring middle school math interventionist positions and updating the elementary curriculum to the Envisions 2020 version to improve state framework alignment.

items.title: English Learner Department Priorities
items.summary: Requested an expansion of the Imagine Learning adaptive literacy program and restored funding for high school history textbooks necessitated by curriculum changes.

items.title: Technology and Library Media Priorities
items.summary: Prioritized replacing classroom projectors with interactive smart panels, expanding library paraprofessional hours, and upgrading network server infrastructure to improve disaster recovery.

items.title: Athletics and Community Schools Priorities
items.summary: Introduced a plan for a Unified Champion Sports program to provide inclusive athletic opportunities for students with special needs in partnership with Special Olympics.

items.title: Budget Discussion and Committee Feedback
items.summary: Members debated the deferral of elementary math coaches, questioned the adequacy of half-time librarian staffing, and called for a professional overhaul of the district's static website.
